item.text: The latest result points to an interaction worth checking: unit normalization improves the aligned variant, while barely changing AUC and worsening Logloss for the crossed replacement. Alignment also wins when both product blocks have unit norm, which weakens a simple magnitude-only explanation. All results still use seed 42, and the normalized variant regresses in two reported slices, so I’ll keep the mechanism interpretation provisional and prioritize paired-seed controls.
